title: Exhaustive 2x2x2 ER-Tile Readout-Degeneracy Scan
status: EXHAUSTIVE CONTROLLED SANDBOX ENUMERATION / NOT PHYSICAL DARK-MATTER WITNESS
state_space_encoding: Each of 8 tile sites is one of {-1,0,+1}: negative chirality occupied, empty, positive chirality occupied.
robust_definition: Within a single top-down readout class, at least one pair has nonzero H and O probe ER-response separation for p=0 and p=1 under both possible ER chirality-index conventions.
main_result: Readout degeneracy with cross-probe ER distinguishability is widespread in the complete controlled native-cell state space, not unique to the hand-selected E001 pair.
hard_boundary: The {-1,0,+1} site encoding and top-down readout are the controlled E009 sandbox grammar. This exhaustive scan does not prove all enumerated states are physically admissible MK43 states.
